scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Three cloaked men in sandals climb a sunlit rocky mountain path. The oldest touches the rock ahead as the others follow. Golden grasses, small flowers and hardy shrubs grow among pale stones, with a distant village, valley and blue mountain ridges below.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The three climbers imaginatively represent Peter, James and John following Jesus up the high mountain in private. Jesus is understood to be ahead beyond the bend and is not depicted. The landscape, clothing, ages and sunlight are artistic choices; the verse does not identify the mountain or time of day. This scene shows the ascent, without importing the Transfiguration from the following verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Three robed men, seen from behind and in profile, gaze toward white-gold radiance above pale mountain rocks. One raises an open hand, and another rests a hand on his companion's shoulder. Blue-violet ridges and sparse shrubs surround the warm watercolor scene.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This indirect, imaginative view places the witnesses below the radiance of Jesus' transfiguration while keeping Him outside the frame. The reflected light evokes His face shining like the sun and His clothes becoming white as light. The rocky setting, clothing and gestures are artistic choices, not details supplied by this verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Watercolor of two bearded men among sunlit mountain rocks. A white-haired man in a cream robe and ochre mantle gestures with an open hand; a dark-haired man with a greying beard and russet mantle rests a hand at his chin. Both look toward the upper right, with blue ridges behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: Moses and Elijah are imagined in a rocky mountain setting, turned toward Jesus beyond the right edge as they converse with Him. Their appearance, clothing and setting are artistic conventions; the verse does not describe those details or quote their words. Jesus remains outside the frame, without a substitute symbol.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A gray-streaked, bearded man in a cream robe and ochre-brown cloak kneels in a rocky mountain clearing, looking upward with open hands. Small flowers and shrubs grow among the rocks, and blue-violet ridges stretch beneath a pale, clouded sky.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The kneeling man imaginatively represents Peter speaking to Jesus beyond the frame. His open hands and the empty clearing suggest his willingness to make three shelters, a conditional offer rather than completed buildings. His posture, clothing and mountain details are artistic choices, not historical likeness or site evidence. Jesus, Moses and Elijah are not shown.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Three men in cream tunics and blue, olive and rust cloaks stand among warmly lit mountain rocks, looking into an immense luminous cloud. One raises an open hand; another rests a hand on a boulder. White-gold mist surrounds them, with distant purple ridges and small wildflowers.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The bright cloud and attentive listeners visualize the verse's interruption and command to listen. The three disciples, mountain landscape, gestures and garments are imaginative staging, not details supplied by this verse or historical likenesses. Jesus is outside the frame; the Father's voice and His declaration are not given a visible form. The cloud is the narrated cloud, not a substitute image of Jesus.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Three robed men lie facedown in a rocky mountain clearing, their heads lowered onto their arms. Olive, ochre and terracotta cloaks catch warm cloud-filtered light. Small flowers, grasses, leafy branches and distant lavender mountains surround them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The lowered faces and close-held hands picture the disciples' great fear after hearing. Three figures, the mountain clearing, clothing and luminous cloud are imaginative staging; this verse describes their response without specifying those visual details. God and Jesus remain outside the frame.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Three bearded men in cream tunics and olive, terracotta, and blue mantles kneel among sunlit rocks and small flowers, looking upward. A hand from an ivory sleeve at the right rests on the nearest man's shoulder. Blue hills recede beneath a pale sky.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The shoulder touch and followers beginning to rise picture Jesus approaching, touching them, and saying to rise without fear. Only His hand and sleeve appear; His face and body remain outside the scene. The three followers, their appearances, clothing, and rocky setting are imaginative choices, not details specified by this verse. No lettering depicts the spoken words.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Three men in cream tunics and rust-brown or olive mantles sit on a rocky mountain ledge, lifting their faces toward a point above the picture. Small flowers grow between sunlit stones, with layered blue-green ridges beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative watercolor shows the disciples lifting their eyes toward Jesus, who remains just outside the frame. Their shared gaze recalls that they saw Jesus alone; the mountain setting, garments and faces are artistic conventions, not details established by this verse or historical likenesses.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Three robed men descend a rocky mountain path, turning toward an open hand entering from the right. Blue, russet and olive cloaks glow in warm light among pale rocks, dry grasses and olive branches, with distant blue hills beneath a clouded sky.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative mountain descent shows three attentive followers receiving Jesus' instruction; only a hand at the edge suggests His presence. Their quiet attention recalls the command to keep the vision private until His resurrection. The vision and resurrection are not shown. The faces, garments, number shown and landscape are artistic conventions, not historical evidence.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Two bearded men in cream tunics and terracotta and olive mantles stand on a rocky path beneath an olive tree. One extends an open palm toward the left; both look that way. Golden grasses, purple flowers, a distant village and lavender hills fill the warm watercolor landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The open-handed question imaginatively represents the disciples asking Jesus about the scribes' teaching that Elijah must come first. Jesus is outside the frame. Elijah and the scribes are mentioned in the question, not shown as present. The two figures, clothing and hillside village are artistic conventions, not established likenesses or a verified location.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A winding pale stone path runs between low dry-stone walls through a sunlit olive grove. Wildflowers and grasses edge the terraces; a small hill village and blue mountains lie in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The stone path and walls set in order amid a flourishing olive grove are an imaginative reflection on restoration. The verse does not describe this landscape or a repair event, and Elijah is not shown as present. This visual analogy does not exhaust the saying that he will restore all things.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Three bearded men in earth-colored robes listen solemnly toward the left on a rocky hillside path. Two sit on stones and one stands behind them. An olive tree arches above the shaded bend, with wildflowers, sunlit hills and a softly clouded sky beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: These anonymous listeners are an imaginative response to Jesus' warning, not portraits or a documented arrangement. Their concern reflects Elijah's rejection and mistreatment and the Son of Man's coming suffering. The path entering shadow is a visual analogy for that warning. Jesus remains outside the frame; neither the past mistreatment nor the future suffering is enacted.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Three bearded men in cream tunics and rust, olive and blue mantles stand on a rocky, flower-lined path beneath an olive tree. One opens a hand, one touches his chin and one holds a hand to his chest as they look left. Sunlit hills and a small village lie behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The disciples' attentive faces and gestures imaginatively convey their new understanding. The three figures, hillside, garments and daylight are artistic conventions rather than details supplied by this verse. Jesus remains outside the frame; John the Baptist is the person being discussed and is not portrayed as present.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man in a cream tunic and rust-colored mantle kneels on a stony path, looking upward to the right with open hands. A crowd watches beneath an olive tree; pale buildings and blue hills recede beyond dry grass and limestone rocks.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The kneeling man and watching crowd visualize the approach described in the verse. His gaze is directed toward Jesus beyond the right edge; Jesus is not depicted. The clothing, olive grove and hillside village are imaginative setting details, not particulars given by the verse. The later petition and healing are not shown.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Watercolor of a bearded man in cream and ochre kneeling beside a weary boy in green. He holds the boy close and lifts an open hand, looking upward. An olive tree shades the rocky path, with pale hills and a stone village beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The father's open hand imagines his appeal for the Lord's mercy, while his supporting arm and the boy's weary posture convey severe suffering. Jesus remains outside the frame. The boy's age, clothing and setting are artistic choices. The verse reports repeated falls into fire and water; those dangers are not depicted as happening here, and no completed healing is claimed.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Watercolor of a weary boy in ochre seated beside a bearded man who supports his shoulder. Three robed men look on with concern, one holding out an open hand, beneath an olive tree beside a stone wall and sunlit hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative recollection of the unsuccessful appeal reported in the verse. The man and boy visualize the speaker and the person he brought; their ages, faces, garments and setting are artistic choices. The disciples show concern and helplessness. Jesus remains outside the picture, and no healing is shown.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man in a russet cloak guides a curly-haired boy in a blue-gray tunic toward the right. Four robed men watch soberly beneath an olive tree. Rocks, wildflowers and distant pale village houses fill the warm watercolor hillside scene.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The boy and guiding adult imaginatively stage the command to bring him to Jesus; his age is not specified in this verse. Four sober listeners evoke the generation receiving the rebuke. Jesus remains outside the frame, and no healing is depicted. Faces, garments and landscape are imaginative conventions, not historical likenesses.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A watercolor of a curly-haired boy in an ivory tunic and russet sash, seated upright on a limestone rock with his hands on his knees. He smiles gently and looks upward to the left. Olive branches frame a sunlit path, golden grasses, purple wildflowers, distant hills and a small stone village.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The painting imagines the immediate aftermath: the boy is calm and restored after Jesus' rebuke drove the demon out. His upward gaze is directed toward Jesus beyond the frame. His age, clothes, seated pose and hillside village setting are artistic choices rather than details specified by the verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Four bearded men in cream tunics and green, blue, rust and ochre mantles sit beneath an olive tree beside a stone wall. The central man holds both palms open while the others look thoughtfully toward the upper right. Warm hills, a distant village and small wildflowers surround them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The four men represent the disciples who approach Jesus privately. The central man's open hands and the group's off-frame gaze imagine their question about their inability to cast it out; Jesus remains outside the picture. The olive-tree recess, clothes and faces are artistic choices, not details specified by this verse or historical likenesses. No casting out or answer is pictured.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A small brown seed rests in an open palm above a linen sleeve, before a sunlit rocky mountain. Olive branches, scattered trees, wildflowers and golden grass fill the warm watercolor landscape beneath a blue sky.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The seed and immense mountain illustrate Jesus' comparison and His promise about mustard-seed faith. The anonymous human hand supplies scale in an imaginative teaching composition. It is not a portrait of Jesus or God, and the mountain at rest does not claim that this verse records a mountain actually moving.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Five bearded men in cream tunics and blue, olive, ochre and russet mantles sit on rocks beneath an olive tree, gazing attentively to the right. An older gray-bearded man clasps his hands at the center; a lake, distant hills, a small village and wildflowers fill the warm watercolor landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The listening companions imagine the gathering in Galilee as Jesus announces that the Son of Man will be handed over to men. Jesus is outside the frame; their serious attention carries the weight of the spoken prediction without depicting the later betrayal or arrest. The lakeside olive grove, clothing and individual faces are imaginative choices, not details supplied by the verse or historical likenesses.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Five sorrowful men in earth-colored robes gather beneath an olive tree. One bends forward with a hand on his head; another weeps with his hands on his knees. A standing companion rests a hand on a shoulder, while the man at right looks upward. Sunlit hills and a pale stone village lie beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene focuses on the disciples' deep grief as they hear Jesus predict His killing and resurrection on the third day. Jesus remains outside the frame; neither future event is enacted. The five figures, hillside, garments and gestures are artistic choices, not details specified by this verse. Warm light quietly suggests hope without claiming that the disciples already grasped the promise.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man in a red mantle listens as a man in olive raises an open hand beside a second man in brown. A leather pouch hangs at the speaker's waist; sunlit stone houses, an olive tree and a blue lake surround them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: Peter listens to two collectors asking about his teacher's two-drachma payment. The closed pouch and questioning gesture evoke their task without showing an answer or payment. Their appearances, clothing and lakeside Capernaum setting are imaginative; Jesus remains outside the frame.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man in a cream tunic and ochre mantle pauses in a sunlit stone doorway, one hand resting against the wooden post. He looks up thoughtfully into the room. A clay pitcher and folded striped mat sit against the plastered wall.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: Peter's pause at the doorway imagines the moment Jesus addresses him on entering the house. His attentive gaze points toward the speaker, who remains outside the picture. The domestic setting and Peter's appearance are imaginative, not a historical likeness. The kings, sons and strangers belong to Jesus' question about taxes; they are not visitors in the house.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Watercolor of a bearded man in an olive tunic and cream mantle, seated on stone beside an open wooden doorway. He looks upward to the right with a gentle smile, his empty hands resting on his knees. Vines, clay vessels, flowers and warm sunlight fill the stone courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The unnamed listener's attentive expression imagines the moment of understanding Jesus' conclusion. The open doorway suggests the sons' freedom from the payment without staging the analogy as an event. The courtyard, clothing and gesture are imaginative details; the verse does not specify them. Jesus remains outside the picture.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Two weathered hands in cream sleeves hold a silvery fish beside a blue lake. One hand opens its mouth, revealing a silver coin. A bronze hook and pale line rest on a wet foreground rock, with reeds, an olive branch, and sunlit hills behind.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative close view pictures the discovery Jesus promises, rather than claiming the verse narrates its completion. The fish, coin, hook and lake connect to His instructions; the hands, shoreline details and daylight are artistic choices. The single coin relates to the payment for both mentioned in the verse. Jesus remains outside the frame.
